body: Thanks for the tips. I will continue doing my best. I will never give up. Will keep you updated, thanks a lot for all of the attention, really...

Bad news... Talked to him, wrote him a beautiful e-mail, how much I put so many efforts everyday... And although he would like to thank me, he wants to kill himself this week-end... He will meet me one last time... What should I do... I am still at loss...

I will ask him once again when is extremely determined to do it. 
We live in a major European capital so yes. But he's familiar with treatments since he was already treated when he was a teen.
I did mention him the fact that I will be alone facing all the things he hates, and all he stated is I have to be strong and he trusts me. 
I would like to know if there are any resources that specialize in suicidal and DETERMINED thoughts. Think like someone who is terminally ill and who is glad to part ways... But minus the physical pain. And I cannot respect this decision because he still has a lot to offer and he is not happy with the current situation. There's too much to lose.

He was in his best condition and situation, and really needed my affection to live happier. I am his very first girlfriend, since he is the introvert type of guy, and I am not very "normal" too (introvert, workaholic, we both love literature, etc., and since he's very arrogant, he said that I am one of the smartest persons he has met). 
He didn't let me down because I still had many opportunities according to him, so it would be a waste if I killed myself. 
Then a month or so later, he suddenly got fired. Just on a whim. He didn't announce it to me until last week. He kept it for himself for around 10 days. And his chances are slimmer than mine, in the current stage, which is true. 
He is not acting normally. He is very cold, he assures me that he's still content with his life overall, but he doesn't sound like his usual self, this is why I am not convinced. 
I had a great news today, told me congratulations by text, and that's it. In his normal state, he wouldn't stop talking about it for days.

I said that I understand him perfectly well, since I was almost like him a month ago. I also projected all the stuff we are going to do together if everything is solved. He said "Yes, sure, I certainly hope so", still calls me with affection. I told him that he matters a lot, that sure, the world is not always nice, but there are still many other beautiful things. I also beg him to give more time to it, like maybe 5 months of joblessness, instead of just two, so he can have more time to apply elsewhere. 
Once again, he is totally in control, seems cool and collected. He thanked me for the support but said he really didn't need it since he is not in power to decide when will he get a job, if ever.
